EARTH TRENDS OBSERVATORY

Project credits

Project lead: William Osei Aborah. William selected the Earth-trends task and practical focus, directed the project and presentation, reviewed the result, and approved its submission for the Kumasi Local Event.

ChatGPT / OpenAI Codex assisted research, code, analysis, writing, design and presentation. The application uses deterministic calculations; its NASA data are authentic and are not AI-generated.

NASA POWER provides the meteorological data. The trend methodology adapts the challenge-listed Acker et al. (2009) NASA resource. See the application’s sources and limitations for details.
